plugins.name: compact-carry
plugins.description: Carries recent files, the last request, open todos and the branch across a compaction as a short note

plugins.name: context-gauge
plugins.description: Band above the prompt: context fill, last turn's cost, session and subagent cost and rate limits; /gauge toggles it

plugins.name: prompt-shaper
plugins.description: Attaches git state to a prompt when it changed, and adds a stable project-toolchain note to the system prompt

plugins.name: long-turn-notify
plugins.description: macOS notification when a long turn finishes, or when Claude needs your input, in terminal sessions

plugins.name: merge-gate
plugins.description: Holds gh pr merge until CI passes on the PR head; /gate runs the project CI steps locally without a Claude turn

plugins.name: secret-scrubber
plugins.description: Masks API keys and tokens in tool output before Claude or the transcript sees them, and refuses writing them into source files

plugins.name: test-on-edit
plugins.description: When Claude's answer ends, runs the tests of the files it edited; failures go to Claude with your next prompt; refuses deleting or disabling tests (skip, xfail, only), flags dropped cases

plugins.name: next-steps
plugins.description: Suggests 2-3 likely next prompts after each turn, press 1/2/3 to draft one; /next off

plugins.name: mod-stats
plugins.description: /mod-stats [days] [here]: what each mod did, cost and saved, active/stale/dormant, hook time and faults; watches the other mods' hooks for faults
